processNotes.reviewResultTrap: A review workflow returning an EMPTY finding set may mean the LENSES CRASHED, not that the diff is clean. Check the run's failures list + journal.jsonl before treating empty as a pass (seen at 9.3).
processNotes.firstImplementerTrap: A subagent can return an anomalous 0-edit 'done', and a dead subagent can leave a NON-COMPILING tree (seen at 11.4). ALWAYS git status + build/run before trusting anything.
processNotes.mutationThenRead: Mutation-test a green suite to prove it discriminates, THEN read the diff anyway — C-033 survived both a green suite and two successful mutation checks, and was caught only by reading a comment that lied about the code below it.
processNotes.reviewFixRevertTrap: VERIFY every revertAssertion row by actually running the revert. At 9.4a, removing the !edge.repairable branch did NOT re-red [C032-D1] (that test runs at testRepairAttempts:0). All four of 11.4's revert claims were run.
